description: Configure a website directory alias for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test'. Map the URL path '/marketing' to the server filesystem path '/var/acme_marketing'. The directory '/var/acme_marketing' already contains a file named 'press_kit_v1.txt'. Your goal is to make this file accessible at 'http://acmecorp.test/marketing/press_kit_v1.txt' by configuring an Apache Alias (NOT a Redirect). You can do this via the 'Aliases and Redirects' or 'Edit Directives' section in Virtualmin. Ensure the configuration is applied and the file loads successfully in a browser.
